title: A Returning Customer
description: Siegfria can't stop thinking about the delectable Jade Parcels. Oh how she wants to taste it again...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Returning Customer
mainQuestExcel.description: Siegfria can't stop thinking about the delectable Jade Parcels. Oh how she wants to taste it again...

dialogs.text: How am I already hungry again...
Oh, it's you! Wonderful. Do you still remember me?
From the cook-off, with Xiangling? That was me, Siegfria!
Hehe, do you remember now? Anyway, you've come at a great time. Could I... ask you to help me with something?
What do you need?
Do you still recall the Jade Parcels that you made the previous time?
They were so delicious, I can still taste them, even now.
So I wanted to give it a try and make some myself, but... it always feels like there's something missing...
I feel like if I get to try it a few more times, I can recreate that flavor too!
So, could I ask you to make some Jade Parcels for me to try?
I'll see it done.
Great! Thank you so much. I'll be waiting over here.
Hehe... I'll finally be able to eat Jade Parcels again...
Would you like anything else?
Ugh, well... I'd also like to eat other things. But if I tried to eat everything, then I wouldn't be able to eat anything at all.
So I'd like to get a firm grasp on how Jade Parcels taste first.
This is great! I'll finally get to taste the Jade Parcels you make again.
I do know the recipe, and I have been able to figure out how to make it, but it doesn't quite match the flavor it had when you made it.
*sigh* If only you could make those Jade Parcels for me a few more times. There are still many intricacies to them that I have yet to work out.

flow.stepDescription: Give the Jade Parcels to Siegfria

dialogs.text: ...Ah, they're all gone.
The mouthfeel of those vegetables... the perfectly paired flavors of the ham and the lotus... and that soup...
This is it — this is the flavor that I tasted the last time!
Thanks for coming over just to make me this dish. I need to go back and make some notes.
Next we meet, I will definitely be able to make a batch of perfect Jade Parcels.
When that time comes, do swing by to have a taste.
The freshness of the ham, the mouthfeel of the vegetables, and this faint spiciness...
Hmm, this is not bad. It's a really good serving of Jade Parcels!
